question: Your NestJS worker consumes from an SQS queue, and sometimes the same message gets processed twice. Why does this happen, and how do you design around it?
Design the inventory and checkout flow for an Amazon Lightning Deal: 10,000 units, a million shoppers clicking 'Buy' at the same moment. How do you avoid overselling while staying fast?
Explain the testing pyramid. In a React + NestJS app, what would you unit test, integration test and end-to-end test?
Your Node.js Lambda functions talk to PostgreSQL on RDS. During a traffic spike the database starts rejecting connections with 'too many clients'. What's going on and how do you fix it?
You add Redis caching in front of a slow product API. Compare cache-aside, write-through and write-behind, and explain how you'd handle a cache stampede.
What's the order of execution between process.nextTick, Promise.then, setTimeout(fn, 0) and setImmediate in Node.js?
How would you deploy a change to a service running across many regions so that a bad release hurts as few customers as possible? Walk me through blue/green, canary and automated rollback.
In 2017 a single mistyped command took down Amazon S3 in us-east-1 for hours. How do you design systems and operational tooling so that one mistake can't take everything down?
Design Amazon's 'Notify me when this item is back in stock' feature. Millions of users may subscribe to a popular item.
A user clicks 'Pay' and their network drops; the client retries. How do you design the payment API so the customer is never charged twice?
SQS, SNS and EventBridge all move messages between services. When would you pick each one?
What is a Lambda cold start, why does it happen, and how do you reduce its impact on a Node.js API?
Your Node.js Docker image is 1.2 GB and builds slowly. How would you make it smaller and faster to build?
What's the difference between vertical and horizontal scaling, and why do people say your web servers should be stateless?
Explain SSR, SSG, ISR and client-side rendering in Next.js. Which would you use for a product listing page, a product detail page and a user dashboard?
Amazon's shopping cart was the motivating example for Dynamo. Why would Amazon choose availability over strong consistency for 'Add to Cart'?
Your service's average latency looks fine, but p99 just doubled and customers are complaining. Walk me through how you'd investigate using AWS tooling.
A query like SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1 AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 is slow on a 50-million-row table. How do you diagnose and fix it?
Design a rate limiter for a public API so each user can make at most 100 requests per minute, across many API servers.

When a customer clicks 'Place Order' on Amazon, the order, payment, inventory and shipping services all need to agree. How do you coordinate this across microservices without a distributed transaction?
What is a closure? What does this print, and why: for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { setTimeout(() => console.log(i), 0); } How would you fix it?
How is the value of 'this' decided in JavaScript? How do arrow functions change it, and what do call, apply and bind do?
What's the difference between 'interface' and 'type' in TypeScript, and what happens to your types when the code actually runs?
Why does React warn you to add a 'key' to list items, and what goes wrong if you use the array index as the key?
What does a load balancer do? Explain the difference between Layer 4 and Layer 7 load balancing and a few common balancing algorithms.
Microsoft Teams shows whether a colleague is online and pushes new messages instantly. Compare short polling, long polling, Server-Sent Events and WebSockets. Which would you use?
Implement a debounce function from scratch. How is it different from throttle, and where would you use each?
In MongoDB, when do you embed related data inside a document and when do you reference it in a separate collection? Walk me through modeling users, orders and order items.
Microsoft runs aka.ms to turn long URLs into short links. Design a URL shortener like it: creating short links, redirecting fast, and handling billions of clicks.
Design the messaging backend for Microsoft Teams chat: 1:1 and group chats, message history, and delivery to users on multiple devices, including ones that are offline.
What happens, step by step, when you type google.com into your browser and press Enter?
What's the difference between authentication and authorization? Compare session-based auth with JWTs. Which would you use for a Next.js app with NestJS microservices?
Explain useEffect's dependency array and its cleanup function. Why might an effect run in an infinite loop, and why does it run twice in development?
What's the difference between React.memo, useMemo and useCallback? When do they actually improve performance, and when are they wasted?
Explain the SOLID principles with a small example from a backend you've built.
Your checkout supports cards, UPI and wallets, and product wants to add 'Pay Later'. How would the Strategy pattern help, and how would you wire it up in TypeScript?
In the Next.js App Router, what's the difference between Server Components and Client Components? How do you decide where the 'use client' boundary goes?
Build a Google Search-style autocomplete box in React. As the user types, show suggestions from an API. How do you keep it fast, correct and accessible?
Design and implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with get(key) and put(key, value), both in O(1) time, and a fixed capacity.
Do a low-level design for meeting booking in Google Calendar. Users can create events, invite attendees, check for conflicts, and find the first free slot shared by a group.
What is middleware in Express? What does next() do, why does the order of app.use() calls matter, and how is error-handling middleware different?
In NestJS, what are modules, providers and controllers, and how does dependency injection work? Why is it better than just calling new UserService() yourself?
What is a CDN and why does it matter for a video service? Netflix built its own CDN, Open Connect, instead of only renting one. Why might they do that?
Netflix famously moved from a monolith in its own data center to hundreds of microservices on AWS. What are the real pros and cons of microservices versus a monolith, and when would you NOT split?

Netflix stores viewing history for hundreds of millions of members, while billing needs strict correctness. How do you choose between a relational database like PostgreSQL and a NoSQL store like Cassandra or MongoDB?
Walk me through the NestJS request lifecycle. In what order do middleware, guards, interceptors, pipes and exception filters run, and what would you use each one for?
Users download large PDF reports (up to 2 GB) stored in S3 through your Node.js API, and the server keeps running out of memory. How would you fix it using streams, and what is backpressure?

The Netflix homepage calls dozens of backend services. If the recommendations service becomes slow, how do you stop it from taking down the whole page? Explain timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, bulkheads and fallbacks.
Build a Netflix-style browse page in React: dozens of horizontal rows, each with many poster thumbnails. It feels janky on low-end devices. How do you make it fast?
Design Netflix: studios upload titles, members around the world press Play and stream smoothly on any device and network, and 'Continue Watching' resumes where they left off on any device.
What does ACID mean for a database transaction? Does MongoDB support transactions across multiple documents, and when do you actually need them?
Design the REST API for Airbnb listings and bookings. Which URLs and HTTP methods would you use, what is the difference between PUT and PATCH, and which status codes would you return?
What is the difference between Promise.all, Promise.allSettled, Promise.race and Promise.any? Give a real use for each.
Using MongoDB's aggregation pipeline, find the top 5 hosts by total booking revenue in the last 30 days, with each host's name. How would you write it, and how do you keep it fast?
Airbnb search returns thousands of listings. How would you paginate the results API? Compare offset pagination with cursor (keyset) pagination, and explain what goes wrong with each.
What is the virtual DOM, and how does React's reconciliation decide what to actually change on the page? What makes a component re-render?

Your Next.js app on app.example.com calls your NestJS API on api.example.com, and the browser shows a CORS error, but the same request works fine in Postman. What is CORS and how do you fix it properly?

On PhonePe, people open their transaction history far more often than they make payments. Those reads are overloading the primary PostgreSQL database. What is a read replica, how would you use it, and what is replication lag?
Your Next.js page throws 'Hydration failed because the server rendered HTML didn't match the client'. What is hydration, what usually causes this error, and how do you fix it?

PhonePe users can download a monthly account statement as a PDF. Your Node.js service builds the PDF inside the request handler. During peak traffic, the whole service freezes, even simple health checks time out. Why, and how would you fix it?
